id.instruksi: Robot mau piknik: dengarkan cuacanya, lalu sentuh benda yang harus dipakai.
id.t-panas: Piknik di padang rumput, matahari silau sekali. Pakai apa?
id.t-hujan: Jalan setapak ke danau becek karena hujan. Pakai apa di kaki?
id.t-dingin: Piknik di kebun teh di gunung, tangan kaku kedinginan. Pakai apa?
id.t-hujan2: Gerimis turun saat kita makan bekal di taman. Bawa apa?
id.t-panas2: Main kejar-kejaran di taman siang hari, badan berkeringat. Pakai baju apa?
id.t-panas3: Duduk di tikar di bawah terik matahari, kepala kepanasan. Pakai apa di kepala?
id.t-dingin2: Angin dingin bertiup di tepi danau, leher terasa dingin. Pakai apa?
id.t-dingin3: Piknik sampai sore di gunung, badan menggigil. Pakai apa?
id.t-panas4: Pasir pantai panas, mau main air. Pakai apa di kaki?
id.t-dingin4: Malam di perkemahan, kaki dingin sekali. Pakai apa di kaki?

en.instruksi: Robot is going on a picnic: listen to the weather, then touch what to wear.
en.t-panas: A picnic on the meadow, the sun is very bright. What do we wear?
en.t-hujan: The path to the lake is muddy from the rain. What goes on our feet?
en.t-dingin: A picnic at a tea garden in the hills, our hands are stiff with cold. What do we wear?
en.t-hujan2: A drizzle starts while we eat lunch in the park. What do we bring?
en.t-panas2: Playing tag in the park at noon, we are sweaty. What top do we wear?
en.t-panas3: Sitting on the mat under the hot sun, our head is too hot. What goes on our head?
en.t-dingin2: A cold wind blows by the lake and our neck feels cold. What do we wear?
en.t-dingin3: The mountain picnic lasts until evening and we are shivering. What do we wear?
en.t-panas4: The beach sand is hot and we'll play in the water. What do you wear on your feet?
en.t-dingin4: Night at the campsite, our feet are very cold. What goes on our feet?
